ru: В Auckland Civic Centre Альтаир просит написать жалобу менеджеру: I am writing to complain…, без can't и Hi. Подпись — Yours sincerely и полное имя.
en: At Auckland Civic Centre Altair asks for a complaint to a manager: I am writing to complain…, no can't or Hi. Sign off Yours sincerely with your full name.
es: En Auckland Civic Centre: I am writing to complain…, sin can't ni Hi. Firma: Yours sincerely + nombre completo.
de: In Auckland: I am writing to complain…, kein Hi. Yours sincerely + voller Name.
